'''2007 Worlds Team Brian Hunter LS Mind What You Have Learned''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brian Hunter]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Team).

Team event 10-5-07. Deck title I Sense An Unusual Amount Of Fear... Sheet lists 10 shields.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Brian Hunter]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|Mind What You Have Learned]]
* '''Stage:''' Team
